title: languas tarokoensis
intro: Languas tarokoensis, commonly known as the Taroko ginger, is a type of flowering plant in the ginger family, Zingiberaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Taiwanese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Languas tarokoensis include pain relief, wound healing, and digestive system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerol, shogaol, and other compounds with potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
